title: Mount and retain a SAC installation-tool carrier
instruction: Lower the unloaded three-arm SAC carrier over the prepared studs and centering mandrel. Screw each of the three knurled retainers clockwise until its top is flush with its stud tip and the carrier rests on all three shoulders. Release the parts and withdraw both grippers. Keep the central pressure spindle retracted.
context: Automotive mechanics install a SAC tool carrier before preloading a self-adjusting clutch. This benchmark isolates its unloaded mounting and retention; it does not claim to install a complete clutch.
setup: Original benchmark fixture on the standard station table (top z=0.7475 m). Prepared clutch surrogate centered at (0.24,0) m; three custom 12 mm-major, 3 mm-pitch square-thread studs on a 62 mm radius at 0/120/240 degrees. Centering mandrel is 15 mm diameter. Carrier begins centered at (0.22,0.205,0.8215) m on its passive tray. Three separate 28 mm-diameter, 12 mm-high knurled retainers start on pedestals at (0.12,-0.18), (0.21,-0.20), (0.30,-0.18) m, center z=0.7985 m. Carrier has 14 mm-wide radial slots and a 20 mm central bore; its integral retracted hollow spindle clears the mandrel. All dimensions except documented procedure features are benchmark-authored or derived. Full geometry, masses, inertia, contact coefficients and initial poses are in scene.json and PARAMETER_TABLE.md.
scoring: 0.25 for the carrier on all three stud shoulders, within 0.65 mm lateral / 0.30 mm axial / 0.025 rad tilt; 0.25 per independently threaded and flush retainer. Each needs at least 3.85 clockwise turns with continuous 3 mm/turn descent, and top within 0.30 mm of its stud tip. Score capped at 0.95 until all parts are below 8 mm/s and 0.15 rad/s, both grippers are 20 mm clear, and conditions hold for 2 s. Fixture displacement >1 mm, invalid telemetry, lost part or >0.35 mm inter-part penetration invalidates the trial.
run_limit: 42,000 actions (35 minutes at 20 Hz); authored limit, awaiting native timing validation.
reset_notes: Seed 0; zero jitter. Restore all seven asset origins/quaternions and zero velocities on every reset. No consumables or generated success-state attachments.
fidelity: Manufacturer-grounded unloaded carrier/retainer setup only (LuK section 10.6 p29). Original benchmark geometry, custom upper 12 mm/3 mm square threads, rigid steel, authored masses/friction. Prepared disc/cover/dowels and lower stud ends are fixed. Spindle stays retracted; no diaphragm preload, torque, full clutch installation or real tool interchangeability is claimed. Native physics/expert/Dream/hardware validation not run.
scores: Native expert: not run; Dream-1: not run. Offline ideal tracking is not a physical demonstration.
